reasons.persona_fit: Calm, practical, founder-to-founder tone addressing a small business owner without hype, strictly respecting the no-CTA rule and scope boundaries.
reasons.clarity: Logical structure that clearly turns an abstract concept into a bounded workflow problem and explains each step in plain English.
reasons.actionability: Provides a concrete, low-risk diagnostic process: define the anchor, test manually in one workflow, and verify consistency before automating.
reasons.factual_grounding: All claims are strictly bounded, explicitly citing the knowledge assistant as a local demo on synthetic data with locked public routes.
